name: so-hud
description: See Session Orchestrator status, warnings and session beacons in Claude Code ($.so contract v1), with protection gates for secret-printing commands, rule traps, outward actions and scope collisions.

strictness.title: Strictness profile
strictness.description: Strictness profile shown in the status line and returned by $.so.profile(). locker: rule traps and scope collisions only warn. ausgewogen (default): rule traps are refused and a scope collision asks first. streng: rule traps and scope collisions are refused. On every profile, secret-printing commands are refused and outward actions ask twice in an interactive session.

outwardHeadless.title: Outward actions without a surface
outwardHeadless.description: allow (default): in a run with no surface (plain claude -p) outward actions run with a receipt. deny: they are refused with a receipt. A hurdle, not a guarantee: protected branches and CI stay authoritative.

soRoot.title: Session Orchestrator path
soRoot.description: Optional absolute path to the Session Orchestrator installation
